target.role: fresh whole-journey belonging and placement discovery for STRANGE GAIT
target.position: Whole journey: before the opener, between every non-protected pair, or after the tail. Preserve only Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer; Truth in Noise → Transparency remains available.
target.purpose: Test current structural mutation, emerging adjacent rhythmic freedom and overlooked catalogue transformations. Character changes are allowed; admission still requires purposeful transition, local-run and long-form effect.

sourceWindows: CURRENT 2026 / DELSIN: https://ra.co/reviews/36358 and https://answercoderequest.bandcamp.com/album/halo — the ten-track Halo release was screened. Answer Code Request — D-Fracture was retained from the exact review's techno/dark-drum-and-bass transformation description.

CURRENT EMERGING / OSAKA-KYOTO: https://hizuo.bandcamp.com/album/paradise-shift-time-w-yossshy — both August 2026 tracks were screened. Hizuo — Paradise Shift (ft. Yossshy) was retained from the artist's exact account of jungle-style drum chops shifting into Rhodes and fast broken beats.

ADJACENT 2025 / TRATRATRAX: https://ra.co/reviews/36291 and https://nicknoexit.bandcamp.com/album/a-tropical-entropy — all eleven tracks were screened. Nick León — Broward Boyy was retained from the exact review documenting a slide-guitar opening, techno blast and rapid arpeggio dissolution.

EMERGING 2025 / TWENTY TWENTY: https://hijinxuk.bandcamp.com/album/peril-prediction-join-the-dots — both tracks were screened. HIJINX & NINA — Join The Dots was retained from the official exact-track broken-beat and dub-techno turn.

OVERLOOKED CATALOGUE / EKLERO: https://ra.co/reviews/18697 and https://eklero.bandcamp.com/album/octagon — all four 2016 tracks were screened. Retina.it — Cellular Structures (Original Mix) was retained from the exact review documenting long syncopated-percussion sequences, bubbling bass and electronic noise.

ADDITIONAL WINDOWS: Hoavi's Invariant and 2026 Architectonics, Biorhythm's Encrypted Signals, Jock Club's Bruk In The Days, Nick León's remix package, current Peak Oil, Sickrose Audio, Delsin and Twenty Twenty catalogue windows were screened. Prior Run 53–73 leads and weaker release-level repetitions were excluded.
explorationReceipt.approximateInspectedScope: Approximately 42 named tracks and releases across current releases, adjacent/emerging artists and labels, and overlooked catalogue windows; metadata and attributed descriptions only, with zero audio auditions.
exclusions: All 14 canonical identities, active placement-specific rejects and every untriggered PARKED revisit were excluded. Exact identities and primary discovery lanes retained in Runs 53–73 were not recycled.
The protected internal handoffs Transparency → When We Froze and When We Froze → Stardancer remain unavailable; Truth in Noise → Transparency and every other boundary remain available.
No lead was promoted for recency, reputation, genre, novelty, title or technical cleverness. Release-level claims were not converted into exact-track behaviour.

Energy, density, space, hypnosis, emotional effect, phrase structure, harmonic relation, perceived pulse and mixability remain unknown. Descriptions of tempo, metre and transformation are evidence, not flow verdicts.
rankedLeadSummary: 1. Answer Code Request — D-Fracture: strongest current techno mutation, explicitly compared to a techno remake of dark drum and bass as feedback consumes the stereo field.
2. Hizuo — Paradise Shift (ft. Yossshy): strongest current emerging exact transformation, moving from jungle-style drum chops into Rhodes and fast broken beats.
3. Nick León — Broward Boyy: strongest compact different-world arc, moving from slide guitar into techno and rapidly dissolving into arpeggios.
4. Retina.it — Cellular Structures (Original Mix): strongest overlooked percussion-first structure, built from long syncopated sequences, bubbling bass and electronic noise.
5. HIJINX & NINA — Join The Dots: strongest emerging Bristol-adjacent broken-beat/dub-techno turn.
